releaseNote:
修复 Judger 初始化顺序导致全部样例无法加载和评测的问题。完善内置浏览器的 ShortestPath 导题入口、评价浮层交互、题解代码与编辑器主题同步，以及浏览器标签宽度。

Fixed Judger initialization order that prevented all samples from loading and running. Improved ShortestPath problem import in the integrated browser, rating popover interactions, editorial code theme synchronization, and browser tab sizing.
